svg.title: IBM Confluent in four editions
svg.desc: IBM Confluent's four editions as IBM lists them: Cloud, a fully managed Kafka service; Platform, self-managed on premises; Private Cloud, on-premises control with the automation of a cloud service; WarpStream, Kafka-compatible streaming in your private cloud.
